---
title: "Not in this version"
---

This page is not in this version.

```{=html}
<script>
// Quarto renders an absolute deployment offset for a website's 404 page.
var offset = document.querySelector('meta[name="quarto:offset"]');
var siteRoot = new URL(offset.getAttribute("content"), location.href);
fetch(new URL("askr-versions.json", siteRoot)).then(function (response) {
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Version manifest unavailable");
  return response.json();
}).then(function (data) {
  var roots = data.versions.filter(function (item) { return item.root; }).map(function (item) {
    var relative = item.root.replace(/^\/+/, "");
    return new URL(relative ? relative.replace(/\/?$/, "/") : "./", siteRoot);
  }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.pathname.length - a.pathname.length; });
  var target = roots.find(function (root) { return location.pathname.indexOf(root.pathname) === 0; });
  location.replace((target || siteRoot).href);
});
</script>
```
